calibration.selectionRule: Embed the byte-exact phone and desktop raw-capsule sample objects from three independent one-attempt candidate runs (20260820-arc1a-candidate2-21af3fa, 20260820-arc1a-candidate3-21af3fa, and 20260820-arc1a-candidate4-21af3fa) plus paired baseline run 20260820-arc1a-baseline3-21af3fa. Reduce every embedded raw capsule rather than trusting copied metrics, faults, or outcome rows. All evidence uses exact isolated Edg/151.0.4129.86, revision @083e754915c9ab93da1d8f7b9c860e4520273900, JavaScript 15.1.23.7, protocol 1.3, measurement authority bb03a3af59cdcc9d4d3773c1396e58b350c27facd99943cbd22028f2236d6a1c, producer authority 291b794e0dcd93ee21d7ff88cbca383e865a62e8dd162573d475131aca3b911e, and candidate/collector commit 21af3fa2c096f0590b067c0af578d7ea29000378. For every profile and field choose a ceiling strictly above the observed three-run maximum, with fractional or +1 sentinels below the next reachable integer or 132px resource quantum for product-owned exact caps and documented rational headroom for variable heap, DOM, encoded-byte, and warm-range fields; require the paired baseline to retain all four sealed faults and multiple ceiling breaches. This Arc-local Edge authority does not re-pin the Gate-A/global browser.
